candidates.change_summary: Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the return value differs when the call succeeds.
Replace `require(_tos.length > 0);` with `require(_tos.length > 1);` so calls with exactly one recipient revert instead of succeeding.
Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0);` check so empty `_tos` arrays no longer cause a revert, changing the outcome from failure to success.
Delete the `revert();` inside the failure check so failed sub-calls are silently ignored and the function succeeds instead of reverting.
